commit.message:
Slice settings-reset-notif: reset all notification settings (#208)

* settings: reset-all notification settings (parity:settings-reset-notif)

* review fixups: confirm-before-reset for notification settings reset

- Gate the defaults dialog's destructive "Reset all" button behind an
  explicit confirm banner (NotificationsConfirm + notifications_confirm
  field, mirroring the SessionsConfirm/WebsitesConfirm +
  sessions_confirm_banner pattern in security.rs): button arms the banner,
  the request fires only on confirm; cancel/dismiss clears it.
- Fix resetAllNotificationSettings schema citations: td_api.tl line 13671,
  not 13670 (chats.rs, tests_chats.rs, notifications test).

Reviewer: PR #208 (parity/settings-reset-notif).

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Muse <muse@quill>

auth: multi-account backend — registry, add/remove, active account (parity:auth-multi-account) (#214)

parity:bots-payment-recurring — Stars subscriptions management (#207)

* parity:bots-payment-recurring — Stars subscriptions management

Adds a ⭐ Subscriptions dialog (chat-list settings menu) listing the
account's star subscriptions via getStarSubscriptions, with star balance,
required-stars banner, pagination, and per-row actions: cancel (inline
two-step confirm) / re-enable via editStarSubscription, rejoin expired
channel subs via reuseStarSubscription. Mutations never update the UI
optimistically — the ok marks the list stale and it refetches from the
authoritative response. Envelope parsers + payload registration, request
builders, state cache + reducer, driver fetch/mutation helpers, tests,
screenshot demo (ready-subscriptions), README box checked.

* fixup: reuseStarSubscription only rejoins active channel subs (can_reuse); expired subs renew via invite_link

- 'Rejoin' button now gated on starSubscriptionTypeChannel.can_reuse:
  schema (td_api.tl 1.8.67) defines reuseStarSubscription as reusing an
  ACTIVE Telegram Star subscription to rejoin the subscribed chat, and
  can_reuse is only true for active subscriptions.
- Expired channel subs instead get a 'Renew' button that opens the type's
  invite_link ('usable to renew the subscription if it has expired') in
  the OS browser via cx.open_url, replacing the mis-wired reuse call.
- Demo fixture: expired channel row now has can_reuse=false and a real
  invite_link so the Renew path renders.
- Corrected the tolerate_gaps test comment: a missing pricing block drops
  the subscription (parse_star_subscription uses ?), zero-valued pricing
  parses fine; behavior unchanged (pricing is non-optional per schema).
- README.md / DECISIONS.md and the builder/driver doc comments now state
  the correct semantics.

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Muse <muse@local>

feat: clear saved payment/shipping info UI (parity:bots-payment-clear) (#204)

Privacy overlay gets a Payments section with a destructive
'Clear saved payment/shipping info...' row. The shared group-confirm
dialog (new GroupConfirmAction::ClearPaymentInfo) asks for
confirmation; on confirm the driver fires deleteSavedOrderInfo +
deleteSavedCredentials (TDLib 1.8.67, lines 15286/15289) via the new
RequestPurpose::DeleteSavedOrderInfo/DeleteSavedCredentials, reusing
the existing request builders from PR #159. Success/failure goes to
the status-note toast (async refusals land on chat_action_error);
demo mode reports 'need a live connection' like other chat actions.

Tests: driver-level RecordingSender test asserting both constructors
dispatch with distinct @extra ids, plus the not-Ready refusal gate.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

parity:calls-swap-prompt — incoming-call-while-busy swap prompt dialog (#202)

First incoming call while another is active raises a kit dialog
(End & answer / Decline) instead of the silent busy auto-decline.
End & answer discards the current call, then acceptCalls the pending
one once the discard lands (no Telegram hold API — said honestly in
the dialog). Esc/backdrop/dismiss declines busy; further incoming
calls while the prompt is open keep the old busy auto-decline.
State: call_swap_pending + call_swap_accept_queued on Session;
driver: decline_swap_call / accept_swap_call / maybe_accept_queued_swap.
Demo fixture + ready-call-swap screenshot demo; 5 new state tests;
2 replay tests updated to the prompt behavior.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
